      Victory is yours to claim

      The battle is paused for this choice. Victory stays available if zones are retaken, but total defeat can still lose the mission. Optional stars and time goals finalize when you leave. Surviving drones return for half their cost; unreleased cargo is fully refunded.

          Field guide

          Frontier maps

          Large worlds apart from the campaign. The Hive lands far from everything: only the beacon is known, so send scouts to find outposts and the city. Results never change your campaign matter or conquests.
